caption_used: 该柱状图展示了五种识别和推理任务在训练集数量、验证集数量及准确率方面的分布情况。蓝色柱代表训练集数量，橙色柱代表验证集数量，灰色折线表示准确率。具体数据如下：实体识别训练集1102、验证集250、准确率0.7666；角色识别训练集1095、验证集190、准确率0.8714（最高）；异常识别训练集1077、验证集40、准确率0.692。空间推理训练集最多为1210，验证集675，准确率为0.4120，虽在所有任务中偏低但仍优于同义识别。同义识别训练集仅5例，验证集55，准确率为0.2852，是所有任务中表现最差的，表明极少量的训练数据严重制约了模型在该任务上的学习能力。
raw_response: This figure presents a comparison of five identification and reasoning tasks across training set size, validation set size, and accuracy. The horizontal axis displays five task categories: 实体识别 (Entity Recognition), 角色识别 (Role Recognition), 异常识别 (Anomaly Recognition), 空间推理 (Spatial Reasoning), and 同义识别 (Synonym Recognition). The vertical axis on the left side represents the number of samples, ranging from 0 to 1210, with numerical tick marks at intervals of 250. The vertical axis on the right side represents accuracy, ranging from 0 to 1, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. Two sets of blue bars represent the training set sizes for each task, with values approximately 1102, 1095, 1077, 1210, and 675, respectively. Two sets of orange bars represent the validation set sizes for each task, with values approximately 250, 190, 40, 675, and 55, respectively. A gray line depicts the accuracy for each task, with values approximately 0.7666, 0.8714, 0.692, 0.4120, and 0.2852, respectively. The tasks are ordered from left to right. Numerical values are displayed above each bar and accuracy value above the line. The highest accuracy is observed for 角色识别, while the lowest accuracy is observed for 同义识别.
